How auto-identification works
Manual IP mapping previews the flow; secure login and user accounts are managed by your administrator.
1 · Map workstation IP

Admin registers a trusted device IP against a user, department and factory.

2 · Verify identity

Users sign in with their local application account.

3 · Open request link

Signed-in users get their mapped name, department and site prefilled in the issue form.

4 · Track to closure

Support team updates assignee, status, work notes and expected completion time in the live queue.

⚙ My Vault Security: PIN, Keyword, Download Password & Voice Lock

🛠 First-Time Personal Vault Setup Instructions
1. Enter your private 4–8 digit numeric PIN and a memorable Secret Keyword (these belong strictly to your login account).
2. Optionally set a Separate Document Download Password to unlock file downloads later.
3. Click Save Vault Security Settings below — your personal encrypted Vault unlocks automatically!
Your personal Vault DEK (256-bit) is wrapped via PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (480,000 iterations) using your own 4–8 digit numeric PIN + Secret Keyword. 5 failed attempts self-lock your Vault until Administrator password verification.
Captures your vocal timbre, pitch (tune), loudness intensity & secret spoken word (e.g. blackpearl). Only a matching voice + tune + intensity + word can unlock.
Record 2 clear samples saying the exact phrase naturally.

Restore a backup
Restore is run on Ubuntu with an explicit confirmation and pre-restore safety backup.

Upload a Northstar server backup archive (.tar.gz). The current database and uploaded attachments will be replaced. The app verifies its checksum and creates a safety backup first.

After restoration, sign in using an account from the restored backup. Server settings and HTTPS certificates remain specific to each server.

SHREE SMARTPHONE PWA & PUSH SETUP (ANDROID 10–17 & iOS)

How to Install App on Mobile (Android & iOS)

When accessing via a local IP with self-signed SSL, Chrome shows a red ✕ badge and disables Install app. Here are 3 fast, 100% working ways:
⭐ Fastest Zero-Config Method: Tap "Create shortcut" In Android Chrome, tap the ⋮ (3 dots menu) → Create shortcut (or Add to Home Screen).
This immediately pins the Shree app icon to your phone screen and opens in full-screen app mode with push notifications, bypassing all SSL restrictions!
🌐 Domain Access via Custom Ports (8848 & 8849):
Open http://swarnshilp.local:8848 (HTTP) or https://swarnshilp.local:8849 (HTTPS). Dedicated ports run safely without conflicting with other web services on port 80/443.
🤖 Download Native Android App (.apk) — Recommended  Direct Install on iPhone & iPad (.mobileconfig — No Mac Needed) 🛠 Developer Xcode Project (.zip for Apple Developer .ipa / Sideloadly) 📜 Download Fresh Shree Root CA Certificate (.crt)
📱 Android 10–17 (Pixel / Samsung / Xiaomi / OnePlus / Vivo): 1. Tap Download Shree Root CA Certificate above (saves shree-server-ca.crt).
2. Install it as a CA certificate in Android Settings:
  • Android 11–17: Settings → Security & privacy → More security → Encryption & credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate → Install anyway.
  • Samsung / Android 10: Settings → Biometrics & security → Other security settings → Install from device storage → CA certificate.
3. Select shree-server-ca.crt, close Chrome completely & reopen this URL. The red ✕ turns into a secure lock, and Install app is enabled!
🍎 iPhone / iPad Direct Install (iOS 14–18 / 26 Safari): Fastest 1-Tap Method: Open this page in Safari → tap Direct Install on iPhone & iPad (.mobileconfig) above → tap Allow → open iOS Settings → Profile Downloaded → Install! The full-screen Shree IT app icon appears directly on your Home Screen (never expires, no Mac needed).
For self-signed LAN HTTPS: Install Shree Root CA above and enable it in Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings.
In-app sound, vibration & popup alerts always work immediately.
